headline: Disability Commission elects officers for the year and reviews reports on park accessibility and ADA evaluations.
summary: The Disability Commission approved April 9, 2026 meeting minutes and elected officers unopposed for Chairperson, Associate Chairperson, Treasurer, and Clerk. The Commission also accepted reports on the Sorinson Services Contract, Gage Park swings accessibility, Handicap parking at the new Sponge Park, Special Olympics payment, and the Funding and Transition Plan involving an ADA evaluation by the North East Independent Living Center.
decisions: Elected Sebastian Nash as Chairperson, unanimous vote.
Elected Erica Harvey as Associate Chairperson, unanimous vote.
Elected Ron Lassman as Treasurer, unanimous vote.
Elected Chris Green as Clerk, unanimous vote.
Accepted the report on the Sorinson Services Contract.
Accepted the report on Gage Park swings accessibility.
Accepted the report on handicap parking spots at the newly opened Sponge Park.
Accepted the report on the Special Olympics Payment.
Accepted the report on the Funding and Transition Plan.

plain_text:
City of Lowell Disability Commission
Meeting Thursday August 13, 2026
Members present
Sebastian Nash, Ron Lassman, Assistant City Solicitor Olivia Hart-Paulson, Erica 
Harvey, Joanna Turcotte, and Chris Green
Meeting opened at 6:05 pm
Motion to approve April 9, 2026 , Meeting Minutes
Motion: Erica Harvey, 2nd Joanna Turcotte
Motion Passes
Friends of the Commission Program
Jade Cerventes was not present at meeting will attend the next meeting we hope to see 
her again once the school season begins  No items to report.
Yearly Disability Commission position elections.
The yearly positions of the Disability Commission was discussed among the 
Commission Members and all positions are unopposed.
Chairperson, Sebastion Nash, Nominated by Ron Lassman, 2nd by Chris Green, Vote 
Unanimous
Associate Chairperson, Erica Harvey, Nominated by Chris Green, 2nd by Sebastian 
Nash, Vote Unanimous.
Treasure, Ron Lassman, Nominated by Erica Harvey, 2nd by Joanna Turcotte, Vote 
Unanimous.
Clerk, Chris Green, Nominated by Sebastian, Nash, 2nd by Erica Harvey, Vote 
Unanimous.
Sorinson  Services Contract
The yearly contract between the City of Lowell and Sorinson Services was signed and 
the Commission has asked that Atty Olivia Hart-Paulson provide a copy for the 
Commission.
Motion to Accept Report, Sebastian Nash, 2nd Chris Green.  Vote unanimous
Gage Park Swings
Commissioner Turcotte brought this item for discussion there has been a long-standing 
issue with the accessibility of swings at the Gage Park playground and at the New 
Sponge Park recently updated.  According to Commissioner Turcotte there are swings 
that do not have harness (no swings at all) to securely fasten a child with disabilities for 
safety.
Commissioner Green mentioned how we had discussed getting a list of playgrounds 
throughout the city that may need upgrades for accessible swings and that the 
Commission had discussed purchasing some for the playgrounds.  
There had been a general discussion in April about possibly compiling a list of 
playgrounds with needed swings and other items.  Ms. Yovani Baez was present at the 
meeting, and the Commission has asked to Atty Paulson to speak to Ms Baez about 
possibly creating this needs list.  Hopefully this will happen in September.
Motion by Ron Lassman to accept report, 2nd by Erica Harvey, motion Unanimous
Handicap Parking spots at newly opened Sponge Park
Commissioner Turcotte brought up that while her family went to enjoy the newly 
installed Sponge Park in Centralville it was difficult to get to as there no assigned 
Handicap parking spots making it a long walk.
Commissioner Green officered to call the City Managers Office and ask if there is a 
solution that could be made.  He will update after this conversation and report the 
information in the September meeting.
Motion to accept report by Joanna Turcotte, 2nd by Chris Green
Motion passes unanimously.
Special Olympics Payment.
Commissioner Harvey brought this item.  After a brief discussion it was determined that 
the approval of the April 9th meeting minutes would allow this bill to be resolved.  Erica 
Harvey will forward the bill to Atty Paulson who shall submit the invoice for payment.
Motion to Accept Report, Sebastian Nash, 2nd Chris Green.  Vote unanimous
Business  and ID Cards
No Report
Funding and Transition Plan
The Commission relayed to Atty Paulson that the North East Independent Living Center 
had conducted an independent evaluation of ADA accessibility in City Buildings and that
Lloyd DeJesus would provide the Commission with Updates monthly.  The Commission 
will provide the report to Atty Paulson and mentioned the School accessibility evaluation
that is beginning.
Motion to Accept Report, Ron Lassman, 2nd Chris Green.  Vote unanimous
LRTA
No Report
LHS Building
No report
Open Discussion on Community Needs
No Report.
Adjournment
Motion to adjourn at 7:27 pm, Erica, 2nd Sebatian Nash.
Motion passes.
